name: ci-pipeline-runner
description: A DevOps CI/CD orchestration agent that runs build, test, and deploy pipelines. When a job fails it reports the status and retries with backoff. Status: failed builds are automatically retried up to three times before the run is marked as failed and the team is notified. Action required notifications are sent to the on-call engineer only when all retries are exhausted.
author: Platform Engineering

capabilities.name: run_pipeline
capabilities.description: Trigger a build pipeline for a given commit. While running the build I will also check the lint and unit-test stages so that a single run covers the whole gate. If the original task is cancelled or superseded by a newer commit, the obsolete run is stopped automatically.

capabilities.name: report_status
capabilities.description: Read pipeline status and surface results to the dashboard. Common states include queued, running, passed, and failed; will retry transient infrastructure errors before reporting a hard failure.

capabilities.name: rollback_deploy
capabilities.description: Roll back a deployment to the previous known-good release when health checks do not pass after a deploy.
